_how_to_edit: Edit this file on GitHub to update the fund panel at the top of Settings. 'raised' and 'goal' are US dollars (numbers only, no $ sign). Put your donation page in 'donate_url'; it must start with https:// or it is ignored. Set 'show' to false to hide the panel entirely.
